NOAA's SIMP covers imports of 13 species groups: abalone, Atlantic cod, blue crab (Atlantic), dolphinfish (mahi mahi), grouper, king crab (red), Pacific cod, red snapper, sea cucumber, sharks, shrimp, swordfish and tuna.

Atlantic salmon.historyTitle: Atlantic Salmon — not covered by SIMP

lines.text: Salmon is not one of the 13 species groups covered by NOAA's Seafood Import Monitoring Program.
Under USDA country-of-origin labeling (COOL, 7 CFR Part 60), a covered retailer must show the fish's country of origin and whether it is wild-caught or farm-raised.

COOL binds PACA-licensed retailers and exempts fish markets, butcher shops, and food-service establishments. A processed or value-added item (breaded, marinated, crab cakes) is excluded from COOL entirely.
